39/S0.subgoal: Explain the three broad categories of interaction in immersive systems.

39/S1.subgoal: Explain the parameters and overview of object selection techniques.

39/S2.subgoal: Describe various hand selection techniques, including travel and intent-driven methods.

39/S3.subgoal: Describe various pointing-based selection techniques, including ray casting and its improvements.

39/S4.subgoal: Describe image plane and volumetric selection techniques.

39/S6.subgoal: Describe indirect manipulation techniques, such as 3D widgets and proxies.

39/S7.subgoal: Describe bimanual and integrated hybrid manipulation techniques.

39/S8.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
